name: idd-skills
description: Issue-driven development (IDD) skills to interactively brainstorm and create GitHub Issues as your local gh user (idd-issue), and autonomously inspect Issues or PR review feedback, implement and verify changes in isolated git worktrees, and create or update pull requests (idd-implement).
suggestedPrompts: Brainstorm requirements and create a GitHub Issue using idd-issue
Check GitHub Issue #123 for ambiguities and post clarification questions if needed
Review requirements for Issue #123, implement in a git worktree, and create a PR
Address PR review comments on PR #45 using idd-implement
